mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID as userId, USER_NAME as userName, COUNT(*) as activityCount, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(CREATE_TIME)) as activeDays FROM TBL_SYSTEM_ACTIVITY WHERE CREATE_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} GROUP BY USER_ID, USER_NAME ORDER BY activityCount DESC

SELECT MODULE_NAME as moduleName, COUNT(*) as usageCount, COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) as userCount FROM TBL_SYSTEM_ACTIVITY WHERE CREATE_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} GROUP BY MODULE_NAME ORDER BY usageCount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as successRate FROM TBL_SYSTEM_ACTIVITY WHERE CREATE_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId}
